messages:
maria.chen: Quick sync — finalizing the launch post + 1-pager for the enterprise benchmark webinar (security / SLA / deploy-modes). Need a short checklist + who owns follow-ups. Rough timeline: draft today, design tomorrow, publish Tue. Thoughts? :fire:

ajay.patel: @maria.chen love it. For the benchmark narrative we should lead with 95th/99th latencies, cost per 100k tokens, and an apples-to-apples throughput comparison vs Competitor X. Can someone pull the latest perf table?

lina.gomez: I can add field notes about common enterprise asks: VPC peering, KMS, explicit SLA numbers, and rollout options (canary, A/B, automatic fallback). I'll draft the one-pager callouts so sales has soundbites.

sam.rao: I'll own inbound routing + webinar CTAs. Proposed lead tags: webinar:benchmark-2026, interest:private|dedicated|hosted, priority:1-3. Plan: HubSpot form -> webhook -> assign AE queue. Also set a Drift quick-message for post-reg signups.

ajay.patel: Also add a short "how it works" blurb: Smart routing + batching + KV/prefix caching => predictable economics. Include a tiny example config for Dedicated reservations (1-2 lines).

maria.chen: Can we include a tiny benchmark chart/box? Need 3 bullets for hero: 95th latency (observed ~50ms), cost per 1M tokens (observed $X), throughput (eg 120 req/s). Sam — can marketing release a short benchmark blurb for social/press once numbers are final?

sam.rao: Yes — I'll draft social + email snippets. Need final numbers from eng by EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: perf-table.csv uploaded to #marketing-assets at s3://redwood-marketing/benchmarks/may2026/perf-table.csv

lina.gomez: On legal/compliance: we need approved wording for "data not logged" for Private and Dedicated offerings. @legal please confirm exact phrasing. Also call out compliance add-ons (SOC2, ISO, FedRAMP note).

ajay.patel: Layout idea for 1-pager: left column = problem & customer pain, middle = why Redwood (3 bullets + mini benchmark), right = deployment map + CTA. Keep it strictly one page — two variants: technical + executive.

maria.chen: Owners: Ajay - copy + benchmark text; Lina - field callouts + compliance blurbs; Sam - lead routing + comms; Design - @design please produce two variants: (A) graph-focused slide-style one-pager, (B) simplified exec one-pager. Deadline: comps by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:

design: noted — will produce two comps. will need final numbers & final copy by 10:00am tomorrow to hit EOD.

maria.chen: Quick QA on claims: avoid unqualified "we're faster" language. Use phrasing like "observed 2x cost reduction in our benchmark (see test conditions footnote)". Ajay add footnote with exact test conditions.

ajay.patel: Will add footnote: model family, token lengths, batching settings, region, instance types.

sam.rao: Webinar follow-up playbook (short): 1) Attach one-pager PDF 2) Send benchmark slide deck 3) Provide demo replay 4) Create HubSpot tag + auto-assign to AE. I'll set up automation sequence post-webinar.

lina.gomez: Field-ready quick snippet for SDRs: 1-liner, 3 bullets, common objections + short counters. I'll drop TL;DR into #sales-ready by EOD.

maria.chen: Also need a 280-char X post + LinkedIn teaser. Sam — can you draft both and ping for quick approvals? Include registration link and a one-sentence outcome.

sam.rao: Draft X post: "How top engineering teams cut inference unit cost by ~2x while keeping p95 latency low. Join our benchmark webinar for configs, playbooks, and decision trees. Register → https://redwood.ai/webinar-benchmarks" — will iterate after final numbers.

maria.chen: Final note: one-pager must include an SLA matrix (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and a simple decision tree: "Need data isolation? -> Private. Need reserved throughput? -> Dedicated. Need fastest time-to-value? -> Hosted." Lina please add decision tree copy.

lina.gomez: Adding decision tree now and flagging known customer phrasing.

maria.chen: If no objections I'll lock the plan and tag owners on the draft. :white_check_mark:

ajay.patel: No objections, locking.

(END)
